page.content:
Picture with bold caption text, the basic unit of many 2000s memes.

How Image macro connects

  • Topic: Meme history — The image macro is the basic still-plus-caption form of 2000s meme history.
  • Work: Lolcats — Lolcats are the breakout cat-photo image macros.
  • Topic: Advice Animal — Advice Animals are a standardized character class of image macro.
  • Work: Pepe the Frog — Pepe was reused as an image macro far beyond the comic.
  • Work: Doge — Doge is a Comic Sans inner-monologue image macro.
  • Work: Rage comic — Rage comics string repeating faces into a short image-macro strip.
  • Location: Something Awful — Something Awful's Photoshop culture fed later image-macro taste.

What is Image macro?

An image macro puts Impact (or similar) type on a still — lolcats, Advice Animals, and countless later formats are species of this form.

Key threads lead to Meme history, Lolcats, Advice Animal, Pepe the Frog, Doge and Rage comic.
